meta_description: Liverpool Gardeners specialises in landscape design, garden maintenance, and outdoor transformations across Liverpool. Local expertise, competitive rates. Get a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Local Garden Experts — 15+ Years Transforming Outdoor Spaces
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete garden design, we transform outdoor spaces you'll love spending time in.
services_subhead: Whether you need a tidy-up, a redesign, or ongoing care, we've got your garden covered.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: From concept to completion, we design and build beautiful outdoor spaces tailored to your home and lifestyle. Patios, decking, pathways, and planting schemes all included.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly visits to keep borders, lawns, and hedges looking sharp. We handle mowing, weeding, pruning, and seasonal tidy-ups so you don't have to.

services.title: Overgrown Garden Clearance
services.desc: Reclaim your outdoor space from neglect. We clear brambles, dead wood, and debris, then leave your garden ready for a fresh start or redesign.

services.title: Lawn Care & Treatment
services.desc: Healthy, thick grass starts with proper care. Scarifying, aeration, feeding, and weed control bring dead lawns back to life and keep established ones pristine.

services.title: Tree & Hedge Pruning
services.desc: Safe, expert pruning keeps trees and hedges healthy and in shape. We handle everything from gentle shaping to removal of dead or dangerous branches.

services.title: Seasonal Planting & Borders
services.desc: Spring bulbs, summer bedding, or permanent shrub borders — we choose plants suited to your soil and light, then plant and maintain them properly.

about_pullquote: A tidy garden makes a house feel like a home. That's what we build for.
about_para_1: Liverpool Gardeners was founded on the simple belief that every home deserves an outdoor space to be proud of. Over the past 15 years, we've helped hundreds of Liverpool families and businesses reclaim, redesign, and maintain their gardens. From small terraced gardens to larger properties, we know the local soil, climate, and what plants thrive here.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on reliability and honest pricing. We turn up on time, do what we say, and treat your garden as if it were our own. Many customers have worked with us for years because we listen, we don't oversell, and we take genuine pride in the work. Whether you need a one-off tidy or weekly care, we're here to make garden life easier.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Garden Owners Say About Us

reviews.text: We had a completely overgrown garden that we didn't know where to start with. The lads came out, cleared everything, laid a new patio, and planted borders that look amazing. Tidy, professional, and fair price. Really happy with the work.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had Liverpool Gardeners out for regular maintenance for two years now. They're reliable, know what they're doing, and genuinely care about keeping the garden looking good. Wouldn't use anyone else.
reviews.author: Catherine M.

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our front garden. Got rid of all the old shrubs and designed something modern that doesn't need constant attention. The team were tidy, friendly, and finished on time. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: David P.
